title: AVERAGE HEIGHT
subtitle: BOYS · BY AGE
voice: High-energy TikTok fitness creator talking straight to camera: upbeat, punchy, fast, big smile in the voice, stress the key words, short snappy pauses.
intro: Average height for boys at every age. Find yours.

rows.say: Ten. Four six. Most boys haven't hit their growth spurt yet.
Twelve. Four eleven. For many, the spurt starts here.
Fourteen. Five four. Often the fastest year of growth.
Sixteen. Five eight. Growth starts to slow down.
Eighteen. Five nine. Most boys are close to their final height.

outro: And you? Comment your age and height.
